# Stakeholder Communication Planning Checklist

## Purpose
This checklist helps Project Managers develop a comprehensive stakeholder communication plan to ensure all stakeholders receive appropriate, timely information throughout the project lifecycle.

## Stakeholder Identification
- [ ] List all project stakeholders (internal and external)
- [ ] Categorize stakeholders by level of involvement (key decision-makers, informed parties, contributors)
- [ ] Identify stakeholder representatives or Customer Advocates
- [ ] Document stakeholder interests and concerns
- [ ] Assess stakeholder influence and impact on project success

## Communication Requirements Analysis
- [ ] Determine what information each stakeholder group needs
- [ ] Define frequency of communication for each stakeholder group
- [ ] Identify preferred communication channels (email, meetings, reports, dashboards)
- [ ] Establish information sensitivity and confidentiality requirements
- [ ] Document any regulatory or compliance communication requirements

## Communication Channels and Tools
- [ ] Set up project status dashboard or reporting tool
- [ ] Create distribution lists for different stakeholder groups
- [ ] Establish project communication channels (e.g., Slack, Teams)
- [ ] Configure access permissions for project documentation
- [ ] Set up automated notifications where applicable

## Communication Schedule
- [ ] Weekly status updates scheduled (specify recipients and format)
- [ ] Monthly stakeholder briefings scheduled (if applicable)
- [ ] Milestone review meetings scheduled with key stakeholders
- [ ] Ad-hoc communication protocols defined for urgent issues
- [ ] Sprint demo/review invitations sent to appropriate stakeholders
- [ ] Retrospective participation defined for stakeholder representatives

## Communication Content Templates
- [ ] Weekly status update template created (progress, risks, blockers, decisions needed)
- [ ] Milestone summary template prepared
- [ ] Risk escalation communication template defined
- [ ] Change request communication process documented
- [ ] Release announcement template prepared
- [ ] Project closure summary template ready

## Feedback Mechanisms
- [ ] Process for stakeholder questions and feedback established
- [ ] Regular feedback collection scheduled (surveys, retrospectives)
- [ ] Stakeholder satisfaction metrics defined
- [ ] Escalation path documented for stakeholder concerns
- [ ] Response time commitments defined for stakeholder inquiries

## Key Milestones Communication
- [ ] Project kickoff announcement sent
- [ ] Phase completion notifications planned
- [ ] Go/no-go decision communication process defined
- [ ] Release readiness communication scheduled
- [ ] Project closure communication planned

## Risk and Issue Communication
- [ ] Risk communication thresholds defined (when to escalate)
- [ ] Issue notification process documented
- [ ] Crisis communication plan established
- [ ] Stakeholder roles in risk mitigation clarified
- [ ] Escalation paths for different risk levels communicated

## Ongoing Management
- [ ] Communication plan documented and shared with team
- [ ] Plan reviewed with key stakeholders for feedback
- [ ] Communication effectiveness metrics tracked
- [ ] Plan updated regularly based on stakeholder feedback
- [ ] Communication responsibilities assigned to team members

## Review and Approval
- [ ] Communication plan reviewed by Project Manager
- [ ] Product Manager approves stakeholder engagement approach
- [ ] Key stakeholders approve communication frequency and format
- [ ] Sponsor or executive stakeholder signs off on plan

## Success Criteria
The communication plan is effective when:
- Stakeholders report receiving appropriate and timely information
- No surprises occur due to communication gaps
- Stakeholder concerns are addressed proactively
- Decision-making is accelerated through clear communication
- Team receives timely feedback and approvals from stakeholders
